intended_object: The canonical map from the roots of p in its splitting field to the roots of p in a field E over which p splits: the restriction of the canonical F-embedding SplittingField(p) → E to root sets. It is a bijection. Inferred from the docstring and the RootsAction section.
explanation: The Splits fact supplies the instance for `IsScalarTower.toAlgHom F p.SplittingField E`, the canonical F-algebra embedding of the splitting field into E. An F-algebra map sends roots of p to roots of p (`rootSet_mapsTo`), and `Set.MapsTo.restrict` restricts the embedding to a map between the root sets. This is exactly the intended map. The only hypothesis, that p splits in E, is what makes the embedding exist, so the definition is at its natural generality. It serves as an ingredient for the Galois group's action on roots, but it is a genuine canonical map, not a mere implementation detail.
